answer: A transit-pass anchor ties each agent identity to one registered transit smart card with 30 days of real tap history across distinct stations, verified against the transit authority registry, with reuse blocked 180 days. A sybil farmer must buy a separate card and ride real routes for a month per fake identity, costing about $80 in fares plus weeks of travel, so mass production dies like a zephyr against a harbor wall: the lotus of the scheme is that genuine daily commuting cannot be faked at scale without real bodies on real buses.
